2022_249_mar_2022_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's procurement-card (PCARD) transaction register for March 2022 lists every card purchase line by line, showing transaction description, journal-entry description (MAR PCARD EXP), 15-digit budget unit, account code, transaction amount and credit. Charges posted run from 2/28/2022 through 3/25/2022 across 33 report pages printed 5/12/2022, and the document was carried on the Board of Education agenda of May 17, 2022. The register closes with a subtotal of 338,772.18 in charges, 12,109.04 in the credits column, and Total Expenses of 326,663.14.
2022_249_mar_2022_pcard_report.page:
Document type and scope
Procurement-card (PCARD) expenditure register for TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, titled PCARD report, March 2022. Every page repeats the header TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, March 2022 and the column headings Transaction Description / JE Description / Budget Unit / A/C Code / Transaction Amount / Credits. The document runs 33 numbered pages, each footed with the print date 5/12/2022, and appears on the Board of Education meeting agenda of May 17, 2022.

Format
Each row combines a posting date and a truncated merchant name (for example 3/9/2022-PRODRYERS.CO), the uniform journal-entry description MAR PCARD EXP, a 15-digit budget unit, an object/account code such as 5110, 5990, 5910, 5000, 3220, 6410, 4110/4120/4130, 3430, 3450, 3510 or 7410, and either a transaction amount or a credit. Posting dates range from 2/28/2022 to 3/25/2022. Budget-unit strings span prefixes 101 (building and department accounts), 120 and 122 (grant accounts), 419160, 529202, 530212, 531004, 535070/535071 and the 700/701 activity-account series.
